title: Associated Bank Earns National Recognition from Fortune, TIME and Newsweek
summary: Associated Banc-Corp (NYSE: ASB) ("Associated") today announced it has been recognized by three leading national publications, earning distinctions from Fortune, Newsweek and TIME.
